description: Audits any SaaS / web application codebase for production readiness and delivers a prioritized report covering security, scalability, reliability, performance, testing, observability, data, APIs, CI/CD, infrastructure, cost, and compliance. Use when the user asks to "make my project production-grade", wants a final check / pre-launch review / hardening / security & scalability audit, or asks whether an app is ready to ship. ALWAYS produces the report first and only applies fixes after the user explicitly approves.
